text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...All right, things are looking good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and I are training for the NHK
Mile
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Keep up the good work, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're in pretty good shape!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama! Inari! Are you guys training too?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, duh! Runnin' is kinda our thing!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We happened to spot ya runnin' while
we were
trainin', so we thought we'd
come say hi. And spy
on ya a bit while
we're at it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're doing pretty amazin', as always. I
bet
you'll be a real threat when we go
head-to-head.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A treat?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A threat! Geez! Ya never think of nothin' but food, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross, Oguri Cap's roommate,
and Inari
One, who's in the same grade
as them, are both
regarded as this year's
rising stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the two are small in stature,
they've
managed to come out on top in
all kinds of
different races. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, whatcha gawkin' at? Bet ya were
thinkin'
how tiny we both are!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whazzat?! You better keep the t-word
outta your
mouth! We're not even that
small!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
To be fair, though, ya are pretty tiny.
Tinier than
me, at least!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Say what?! There's barely an inch
between us! If
you're trying to pick a
fight, I'm game!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why are you even fighting? You're both
short.
That's a matter of fact.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross and Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aargh! Ooof!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What a heartwarming sight. These are
three of
the year's hottest contestants,
but the
atmosphere between them isn't
tense in the
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch them laugh and joke with each
other,
until...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're all having fun. Mind if I
join?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is another up-and-coming

Umamusume from the same year as the
others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Possessing formidable physical prowess,
she's had
considerable success in
long-distance races. This
has put her
name on every trainer's lips.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, Inari... even you, Trainer? How
come you
guys are so quiet all of a
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Do you all have a stomachache or
something? Are
you okay? I can rub your
bellies if you want.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! It's just... you two have
both been
makin' a splash recently, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
From an outsider's perspective, the two
of ya are
enemies! 'Course we're gonna
tense up when the
two of yous meet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Super Creek is a major
contender in
the classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Depending on how well she performs in
the
future, she could present a major
obstacle for
Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Oguri seems like a worthy
opponent
indeed. It looks like I have my
work cut out for
me if I'm racing against
her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh? What makes you say that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I mean, weren't you undefeated back in

Kasamatsu? That's what I heard at least.
Very
impressive. ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: O-oh, you know about that? Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya actin' all flattered for? She's
clearly
tryin' to rile ya up, suggestin'
you're just a nobody
here in the city!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap and Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Was she? ...Was I?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are yous guys for real? I've never seen two rivals look less competitive!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was a little hasty in hopin'
they'd break
out into a spectacular
brawl...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How will these two perform against one
another
in a race? In order to find out,
Oguri Cap will
need to keep improving
her track record in mile
races!
